title: Continental Drift, Evidence, and Theory Revision
sourceLabel: 既存教材をTOEFL形式へ変換 · 元の問1–9に対応
verificationNote: 四つの原文段落と全九つの学習対象を保持し、元の記述問題を英語四択へ変換しました。

passages.text:
Alfred Wegener assembled evidence that continents had changed relative positions. Coastline fit was suggestive, but he also compared rock belts, mountain structures, fossils of land organisms, and traces of ancient climates across oceans. These observations were difficult to explain if every continent had always occupied its present location. His synthesis made mobility a serious historical hypothesis.

Evidence for past arrangement did not automatically provide a physically adequate mechanism. Some mechanisms proposed for continents moving through oceanic crust were incompatible with known forces and materials. Critics were not all defending a fixed Earth out of habit; some asked a legitimate question about dynamics. Ridicule was not a scientific argument, but a missing mechanism was a real weakness.

Mid-twentieth-century ocean surveys changed the evidential landscape. Mapping revealed mid-ocean ridges, trenches, and organized patterns of earthquakes. Magnetic surveys recorded symmetric bands related to reversals of Earth’s magnetic field, supporting creation and outward movement of oceanic crust. Seafloor spreading and subduction connected surface motion to a changing ocean floor.

Plate tectonics did not simply declare Wegener right in every detail. It replaced continents plowing through a stationary seabed with lithospheric plates containing both continental and oceanic crust. The newer framework explained continental displacement while also linking earthquakes, volcanism, mountain building, and ocean-basin evolution. Scientific vindication can therefore involve preserving a core claim while replacing its mechanism and enlarging its scope.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Wegener's original mechanism was identical to modern plate tectonics.

options.label: B
options.text: Scientific revision can retain a central claim while replacing its mechanism and widening its explanatory scope.

options.label: C
options.text: Coastline fit alone proved plate tectonics before ocean surveys.

options.label: D
options.text: Every criticism of continental drift was irrational ridicule.

questions.answer: 正解：B。大陸の相対移動という核心は保存されましたが、固定海底を大陸が進む機構はプレート運動へ置き換えられ、説明範囲も拡大しました。A・C・Dはこの区別を消します。

questions.prompt: Besides coastline fit, which set lists three kinds of evidence Wegener combined?

options.label: A
options.text: Rock belts, mountain structures, and fossils of land organisms across oceans

options.label: B
options.text: Satellite GPS, deep-sea drilling, and computer models

options.label: C
options.text: Only modern earthquake forecasts and volcanic warnings

options.label: D
options.text: Trade records, population counts, and political borders

questions.answer: 正解：A。第1段落は岩体、山地構造、陸生生物化石、古気候痕跡を列挙します。B・Cは後代または本文外の証拠、Dは地質仮説と無関係です。

questions.prompt: The word “suggestive” in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to

options.label: A
options.text: indicating a possibility without being conclusive alone

options.label: B
options.text: mathematically impossible

options.label: C
options.text: already explained by a complete mechanism

options.label: D
options.text: unrelated to any hypothesis

questions.answer: 正解：A。海岸線の適合は仮説を示唆しますが、それ単独で競合説明を排除する決定的証拠ではありません。B～Dは文脈に合いません。

questions.prompt: How does the passage distinguish legitimate criticism from illegitimate criticism of continental drift?

options.label: A
options.text: Ridicule was not evidence, but asking whether the proposed forces and material behavior could produce the motion was legitimate.

options.label: B
options.text: Every criticism was legitimate simply because the theory was new.

options.label: C
options.text: Questions about physical mechanism were ridicule and had no scientific value.

options.label: D
options.text: A missing mechanism proved that all evidence of past arrangement was false.

questions.answer: 正解：A。嘲笑は証拠への応答ではありませんが、既知の力と物質で運動を説明できるかは正当な力学的問いです。B・Cは区別を逆転させ、Dは機構不足から観測証拠まで否定します。

questions.prompt: Why did mid-twentieth-century ocean surveys provide stronger evidence than coastline comparison alone?

options.label: A
options.text: Ridges, trenches, earthquake patterns, and symmetric magnetic bands tested predictions about crustal creation, motion, and subduction.

options.label: B
options.text: They showed that the ocean floor was stationary and featureless.

options.label: C
options.text: They replaced all physical measurements with visual resemblance.

options.label: D
options.text: They proved that continents move independently through fixed oceanic crust.

questions.answer: 正解：A。海洋調査は海嶺・海溝・地震分布・対称磁気縞という独立した観測から、海底生成・移動・沈み込みを検査できました。B～Dは観測と現代理論に反します。

questions.prompt: Which statement is supported by the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Continents independently cut through fixed ocean crust.

options.label: B
options.text: Plate tectonics concerns continents but not oceanic crust.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnetic patterns helped test the creation and movement of seafloor.

options.label: D
options.text: A hypothesis without a mechanism has no evidential value whatsoever.

questions.answer: 正解：C。地磁気反転に対応する対称縞は海洋地殻の生成と外向き移動を支持しました。A・Bは海洋地殻を含むプレート運動に反し、Dは配置証拠の価値までゼロにします。

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the relationship between continental drift and plate tectonics?

options.label: A
options.text: Continental drift identifies changing continental positions; plate tectonics explains them through plates containing continental and oceanic crust and connects them to other geological processes.

options.label: B
options.text: They are identical theories with exactly the same mechanism and scope.

options.label: C
options.text: Plate tectonics rejects any change in continental positions.

options.label: D
options.text: Continental drift explains only magnetic reversals and no surface motion.

questions.answer: 正解：A。大陸移動は相対位置の変化という現象、プレートテクトニクスは海洋地殻も含む運動機構と関連現象を統合する枠組みです。B～Dは両者の継承と更新を誤ります。

questions.prompt: Why does “scientific vindication” here not mean that every detail of Wegener's theory was correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Later evidence supported continental displacement but replaced the idea of continents plowing through a stationary seabed.

options.label: B
options.text: Later science rejected both continental motion and plate motion.

options.label: C
options.text: Vindication requires preserving every original mechanism without revision.

options.label: D
options.text: The modern theory explains fewer phenomena than the earlier hypothesis.

questions.answer: 正解：A。vindicationは核心的主張が支持されることですが、原説の全細部の承認ではありません。現代理論は移動を保存しつつ機構を置換しました。B～Dは本文の結論と反対です。

questions.prompt: Which revision best corrects the claim that Wegener was rejected only because scientists resist new ideas?

options.label: A
options.text: Social resistance and ridicule mattered, but there was also a legitimate demand for a physically adequate mechanism; later ocean evidence supplied a different mechanism.

options.label: B
options.text: Resistance to novelty was the sole cause, and Wegener's proposed dynamics were already complete.

options.label: C
options.text: Because his mechanism was weak, his geological, fossil, and climatic evidence had no value.

options.label: D
options.text: No scientific or social factor influenced the reception of continental drift.

questions.answer: 正解：A。本文は社会的な嘲笑と、物理機構を求める正当な批判の両方を認めます。Aだけがその二層と後の海洋証拠を保持し、B～Dは一方を消しています。
